programs.source: m=eigenpower;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;i=math:std.math;f=matmul(mat:@($f64);vec:@($f64);n:$i64):@($f64){let result=mut.@();let idx=mut.0;lp(idx<n){let sum=mut.0.0;let j=mut.0;lp(j<n){sum=sum+mat.get(idx*n+j)*vec.get(j);j=j+1};result=result+@(sum);idx=idx+1};<result};f=vecnorm(vec:@($f64)):$f64{let sum=mut.0.0;let idx=mut.0;lp(idx<vec.len()){let val=vec.get(idx);sum=sum+val*val;idx=idx+1};<math.sqrt(sum)};f=normalize(vec:@($f64)):@($f64){let norm=vecnorm(vec);let result=mut.@();let idx=mut.0;lp(idx<vec.len()){let val=vec.get(idx)/norm;result=result+@(val);idx=idx+1};<result};f=main():$i64{let a00=mut.0.0;let a01=mut.0.0;let a10=mut.0.0;let a11=mut.0.0;let maxiter=mut.0;let tol=mut.0.0;let line1=io.readln();let parts1=s.split(line1;" ");if(parts1.len()>=2){a00=s.tofloat(parts1.get(0));a01=s.tofloat(parts1.get(1))};let line2=io.readln();let parts2=s.split(line2;" ");if(parts2.len()>=2){a10=s.tofloat(parts2.get(0));a11=s.tofloat(parts2.get(1))};let mat=@(a00;a01;a10;a11);let line3=io.readln();let parts3=s.split(line3;" ");if(parts3.len()>=2){maxiter=s.toint(parts3.get(0));tol=s.tofloat(parts3.get(1))};let x=mut.@(1.0;1.0);let lambda=mut.0.0;let iter=mut.0;lp(iter<maxiter){let xnew=matmul(mat;x;2);let norm=vecnorm(xnew);lambda=norm;x=normalize(xnew);iter=iter+1};io.println(s.format(lambda;"%.4f"));let x0str=s.format(x.get(0);"%.4f");let x1str=s.format(x.get(1);"%.4f");let xstr=s.concat(s.concat(x0str;" ");x1str);io.println(xstr);<0}

programs.source: m=cross;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=ma(prices:@($f64);i:$i64;p:$i64):$f64{let sum=mut.0.0;let j=mut.0;lp(j<p){sum=sum+prices.get(i-p+1+j);j=j+1};<sum/(p as$f64)};f=main():$i64{let l1=io.readln();let params=s.split(l1;" ");let shortp=s.toint(params.get(0));let longp=s.toint(params.get(1));let l2=io.readln();let pstr=s.split(l2;",");let prices=mut.@();let pi=mut.0;lp(pi<pstr.len()){prices=prices+@(s.tofloat(pstr.get(pi)));pi=pi+1};let n=prices.len();let prevstate=mut.0;let savedstate=mut.0;let savedidx=mut.0;let results=mut.@();let i=mut.0;lp(i<n){if(i+1>=longp){let sm=ma(prices;i;shortp);let lm=ma(prices;i;longp);let state=mut.prevstate;if(sm>lm){state=1}el{if(sm<lm){state=2}};if(prevstate=0){savedstate=state;savedidx=i}el{if(prevstate=2){if(state=1){results=results+@(s.concat(s.fromint(i-1);" GOLDEN_CROSS"))}};if(prevstate=1){if(state=2){results=results+@(s.concat(s.fromint(i-1);" DEATH_CROSS"))}}};prevstate=state};i=i+1};if(results.len()=0){if(savedstate=1){io.println(s.concat(s.fromint(savedidx);" GOLDEN_CROSS"))};if(savedstate=2){io.println(s.concat(s.fromint(savedidx);" DEATH_CROSS"))}}el{let k=mut.0;lp(k<results.len()){io.println(results.get(k));k=k+1}};<0}

programs.title: Compound Interest with Regular Deposits
programs.description: Calculate final balance with compound interest and regular periodic deposits.
programs.input_format: Four values: initial_deposit monthly_deposit annual_rate years
programs.source: m=compound;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;i=math:std.math;f=main():$i64{let line=io.readln();let parts=s.split(line;" ");if(parts.len()>=4){let principal=s.tofloat(parts.get(0));let deposit=s.tofloat(parts.get(1));let rate=s.tofloat(parts.get(2));let years=s.toint(parts.get(3));let mrate=rate/12.0;let months=years*12;let balance=mut.principal;let y=mut.0;lp(y<months){balance=balance*(1.0+mrate);balance=balance+deposit;y=y+1};let result=s.format(balance;"%.2f");io.println(result)}el{io.println("error")};<0}

programs.title: Tax Loss Harvesting
programs.description: Identify positions with unrealised losses for tax loss harvesting, respecting wash sale rules.
programs.input_format: Lines of 'ticker buy_date buy_price current_price qty'
programs.output_format: Harvestable losses sorted by loss size: 'ticker loss_amount'
programs.source: m=tlh;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=fget(a:@$f64;idx:$i64):$f64{<a.get(idx)};f=main():$i64{let tickers=mut.@($str);let losses=mut.@($f64);lp(1){let l=io.readln();if(s.len(l)=0){br};let t=s.trim(l);if(s.len(t)=0){br};let parts=s.split(t;" ");if(parts.len()<5){br};let tkr=parts.get(0);let bp=s.tofloat(parts.get(2));let cp=s.tofloat(parts.get(3));let qty=s.tofloat(parts.get(4));let loss=(cp-bp)*qty;if(loss<0.0){tickers=tickers+@(tkr);losses=losses+@(loss)}};let n=tickers.len();lp(let a=0;a<n-1;a=a+1){lp(let b=0;b<n-a-1;b=b+1){if(fget(losses;b)>fget(losses;b+1)){let tl=fget(losses;b);losses=losses.set(b;fget(losses;b+1));losses=losses.set(b+1;tl);let tt=tickers.get(b);tickers=tickers.set(b;tickers.get(b+1));tickers=tickers.set(b+1;tt)}}};lp(let i=0;i<n;i=i+1){io.println(s.concat(s.concat(tickers.get(i);" ");s.format(fget(losses;i);"%.2f")))};<0}

programs.title: Covariance Matrix
programs.description: Calculate the covariance matrix for multiple asset return series.
programs.input_format: Lines of comma-separated returns (one line per asset)
programs.source: m=assetcov;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=main():$i64{let flat=mut.@($f64);let k=mut.0;let n=mut.0;lp(1=1){let l=io.readln();if(io.eof()){br};let tx=s.trim(s.trimsuffix(l;"\n"));if(s.len(tx)>0){let parts=s.split(tx;",");n=parts.len;lp(let c=0;c<parts.len;c=c+1){flat=flat+@(s.tofloat(s.trim(parts.get(c))))};k=k+1}};let means=mut.@($f64);lp(let i=0;i<k;i=i+1){let acc=mut.0.0;lp(let p=0;p<n;p=p+1){acc=acc+flat.get(i*n+p)};means=means+@(acc/(n as$f64))};let denom=(n-1)as$f64;lp(let i=0;i<k;i=i+1){let mi=means.get(i);let outline=mut."";lp(let j=0;j<k;j=j+1){let mj=means.get(j);let acc=mut.0.0;lp(let p=0;p<n;p=p+1){acc=acc+(flat.get(i*n+p)-mi)*(flat.get(j*n+p)-mj)};let cv=acc/denom;if(j>0){outline=s.concat(outline;" ")};outline=s.concat(outline;s.format(cv;"%.6f"))};io.println(outline)};<0}

programs.source: m=compound;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=expf(x:$f64):$f64{let term=mut.1.0;let sum=mut.1.0;lp(let n=1;n<200;n=n+1){term=term*x/(n as$f64);sum=sum+term};<sum};f=main():$i64{let line=io.readln();let parts=s.split(line;" ");let p=s.tofloat(parts.get(0));let r=s.tofloat(parts.get(1));let t=s.tofloat(parts.get(2));let fv=p*expf(r*t);io.println(s.fromfloat(fv));<0}

programs.title: Profit Margin Calculator

programs.input_format: Four values: revenue cogs operating_expenses taxes
programs.source: m=margin;i=io:std.io;i=s:std.str;f=main():$i64{let line=io.readln();let parts=s.split(line;" ");if(parts.len()>=4){let revenue=s.tofloat(parts.get(0));let cogs=s.tofloat(parts.get(1));let opex=s.tofloat(parts.get(2));let tax=s.tofloat(parts.get(3));let gross=revenue-cogs;let operating=gross-opex;let net=operating-tax;let grossmargin=gross/revenue*100.0;let opmargin=operating/revenue*100.0;let netmargin=net/revenue*100.0;io.println(s.concat(s.format(grossmargin;"%.2f");"%"));io.println(s.concat(s.format(opmargin;"%.2f");"%"));io.println(s.concat(s.format(netmargin;"%.2f");"%"))}el{io.eprintln("error")};<0}
